newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Eng wins $190 mln Brazil LPG plant order.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Eng wins $190 mln Brazil LPG plant order.

text.p: Toyo Engineering Corp (TEC) said on Tuesday it had won a $190 million order from Brazil's state-owned oil concern Petrobras to build a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) plant.
TEC, along with Brazilian engineering firm Techint Engenharia SA, won the contract to build a 972-tonne-per-day LPG plant in Urucu, western Brazil, a TEC spokesman said.
The construction of the plant is scheduled to be completed by the end of 1998, and the facility will start commercial operations by June 1999 after trial runs and training of plant workers, he said.
The Export-Import Bank of Japan is to finance a major part of the project, while the remainder of the cost will be arranged by trading house Mitsui & Co Ltd.
Details of the financing are expected to be decided within a month, the spokesman said.
